spans.s:
Ātā.--The framework of the door of a house appears to be denoted by the plural of this word in the Rigveda (though in all passages there it is used only by synecdoche of the doors of the sky), and in the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā. Zimmer compares the Latin antae, to which the word etymologically corresponds.
Foot notes i. 56, 5; 113, 14; iii. 43, 6; ix. 5, 5 (ātaiḥ).
xxix. 5 (ātaiḥ). Cf. ātābhiḥ in durga on nirukta, iv. 18.
Altindisches Leben, 154.
